name: Folded base pan
description: 600 × 400 mm footprint. Folded edges and welded corners; four M8 levelling feet. Detail bends and drain slope before fabrication.

name: Levelling foot
description: Four individually adjustable feet; target bench rating ≥40 kg. Pad and stud shown as one envelope.

name: Rear structural upright
description: TIG welded dry-side support. Frame deflection and weld fatigue require physical verification.

name: Rear cross member
description: Continuous rear frame; weld fixture required.

name: Dry service enclosure
description: Rear compartment: 24 VDC 240 W PSU, motor drivers, controller, safety relay and terminals. Envelopes, not selected supplier mounting patterns.

name: Food / drive partition
description: Sealed rear partition. Moving penetrations require removable boots and catch drains; no bearing exposed over food.

name: Open hopper cassette
description: Approximately 3.4 L geometric volume; 2 L working fill. Open throat 95 × 110 mm. Polished food side Ra target ≤0.8 µm. Removable radiused seams.

name: Hopper lid
description: Lift-off lid with coded interlock. No reach into belt throat while enabled; supplier food-contact declaration required.

name: Slow bridge-breaker shaft
description: Quick-release shaft; external bearings and lip seals behind splash barrier. Intermittent 5–15 rpm; not a kneader.

name: Flexible sweep paddle
description: Soft replaceable blade. Clearance must be tuned to avoid crushing motichoor and trapping peanuts.

name: Agitator gearmotor
description: 24 V BLDC, 20 W, output 5–15 rpm, ≥3 N·m continuous; torque-limited. Coupler and sanitary shaft seal procurement required.

name: Metering belt cassette
description: 210 × 100 mm cassette. 0–35 mm/s coarse/fine feed. Belt may smear besan or bridge sticky jaggery; bench trial is required. Detachable scraper and catch tray.

name: Belt roller
description: Ø20 × 106 mm roller. External sealed bearings and tool-free tension release. Two rollers; return side contained.

name: Belt gearmotor
description: 24 V BLDC 25 W; output 0–35 rpm, ≥1 N·m continuous. 10 mm roller radius. Encoder, current limit, stopped belt while weighing.

name: Removable belt scraper
description: Replaceable thin edge; removes trailing smear into weigh cup. Maximum particle size initially ≤4 mm.

name: Tipping weigh cup
description: Ø96 × 60 mm, 0.40 L. Tares empty before every portion; complete tip cradle and motor sit on cell. 2 g / 3 g provisional accuracy targets, not validated.

name: Single point load cell
description: 2 kg capacity; 24-bit ADC. Fixed end rear, live end cup cradle. Flexible slack wires, no hoses or stiff parallel force path. Overload stops set to cell datasheet.

name: Weighed cradle arm
description: Tip motor and cup supported at live cell end. Bearings, fasteners, motor torque reaction all on weighed structure. Shown as concept bracket.

name: Weigh tip actuator
description: 24 V geared position servo 15 W; ≥1.5 N·m continuous. Tip 150°, return home, then tare. No weighing during tip motion.

name: Shuttle guide rail
description: MGN12-class rail envelope; stainless bellows/cover needed. Two blocks per rail. Travel 160 mm. Lubricant isolated from food.

name: Shuttle carriage
description: Timing-belt drive under catch deck; belt clamp and limit flags require supplier detail.

name: Shuttle timing belt
description: HTD 3M, 9 mm width procurement target; diagram represents belt run. 20-tooth pulley radius 9.55 mm. Tensioner and return run detailed at procurement.

name: Shuttle motor
description: 24 V NEMA17 closed-loop stepper; ≥0.3 N·m at 200 rpm, 30 W budget. 160 mm stroke in 1.2 s; accel 0.5 m/s². Home + end limit sensors.

name: Lower tilt bearing support
description: Rear support clear of every food cavity. Trunnion axis Z225; rear yoke and shaft must connect to cup exterior. CAD support envelope; final bearing and shaft fits need mechanical detail.

name: Lower forming insert Ø46
description: Split spherical cavity. Exchange matched pairs Ø36–64 in 2 mm steps. 0.6 mm equator relief avoids hard rim collision; flash/seam and sticking require food trials.

name: Lower tip servo
description: 24 V 20 W, ≥2 N·m continuous; 120° outward tilt to eject. Home sensor; upper head must be raised before tip. Flexible cable carrier.

name: Press support arm
description: Rear support to press. 150 N design force. Deflection and resonances unverified; hard stop prevents insert contact.

name: Head linear actuator
material: 24 V screw actuator / steel and aluminium
description: 50 W budget; 150 N continuous at ≥40 mm/s; 95 mm stroke. 4 mm lead, efficiency assumption 0.35. Encoder + two limits + load feedback; self-locking not assumed.

name: Head push rod
description: Rod retracts 95 mm. Bellows not represented. Anti-rotation guides, brake or positive retention required; do not rely on software to hold head.

name: Compliant head load module
material: SS304 + spring steel in sealed boot
description: 0–200 N compression sensor; 5 N/mm spring, 2–16 mm usable deflection. Adjustable 10–80 N trial force, hard cutoff 120 N. Spring and sensor shown as envelope.

name: Upper forming insert Ø46
description: Matched upper cavity, lifted 95 mm in home pose. Static split-mould compression; no claim of hand-rolled texture. No orbital cup interference.

name: Matched upper tool spacer
description: Recipe-tool-specific spacer connects solid outside of upper cup to head module. Length 35 minus cavity radius, mm. Provided for every tool size; retained/keyed connection still requires detailing.

name: Output chute
description: Open chute with sidewalls. Removable silicone liner softens drop. Ball exit/release needs sticky-mixture testing; no simulated adhesion model.

name: Collection tray
description: Lift-out tray. Stop on tray-full sensor. No collection reach into moving cup; front interlocked cover.

name: Front lift-off guard
description: Interlocked clear guard; concept panel, not a validated reach barrier. Hinges/latches and complete side guards required before powered operation.

name: User interface enclosure
description: 30 / 50 / 100 g presets; recipe, density, tare, jog, cleaning lockout. Splash-resistant membrane controls.

name: Emergency stop
description: Latching E-stop through safety relay cuts drive enable/power. Independent manual reset; no automatic restart. Exact safety circuit requires electrical engineering review.

name: 24 V power supply
description: 230 VAC 50 Hz input, 24 V 10 A / 240 W output. Target ≥20% electrical reserve. Earthed metal chassis, fused inlet, segregated mains. No heater or compressor.

name: Control and safety module
description: Controller, ADC, servo drivers and monitored safety relay. Shown as procurement envelope; schematic and cable schedule in design document.
